dedupe_keys.name: multi directional cyclic lateral load testing of self centering cross laminated timber wall floor diaphragm sub assemblies

description: Multi-Directional Cyclic Lateral-Load Testing of Self-Centering Cross-Laminated Timber Wall-Floor Diaphragm Sub-Assemblies is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by James Ricles, Lehigh University (lehigh.edu). Driven by demand for sustainable buildings and a reduction in construction time, mass timber buildings, specifically cross-laminated timber (CLT), is being more widely used in mid-rise buildings in the US. Low damage post-tensioned self-centering (SC) CLT shear walls (SC-CLT walls) provide an opportunity to develop seismically resilient CLT buildings. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: Cross-laminated timber; Self-centering; Floor diaphragm; Glued-laminated timber; Gravity load system; Multi-directional lateral loading; Lateral-load response; Damage; Repair; Resilience. Published 2023-12-18. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
